reasons: Regenerating or refining during an edit can write the edit to the wrong answer.
AI and server calls have no retry, and no tests are visible.
Each action catches its errors and shows a message, which is good.

terms.meaning: The language model that writes the text. This app lets the user pick which one.
A way of writing a file, such as an image, as plain text so it can travel in a web request.
The temporary holding place for copied text until you paste it somewhere else.
A function passed in from a parent page, which this panel calls to report a change.

sections.name: File setup, QA
sections.title: Imports and question pair shape
sections.what: Brings in the state tools, the saved profile, the AI model settings and the integration keys. Defines one question-and-answer pair as a question and its answer.
sections.why: Keeps every question and answer in the same shape.
sections.watch_out: Saving and generating code both rely on the field names question and answer, so renaming them breaks saved answers.

sections.name: Props
sections.title: Inputs from the parent page
sections.what: The values the parent page passes in: the job description text, company name, role title, previously saved answers, and a callback that saves answers.
sections.why: Lets the same panel work for any job application.
sections.watch_out: The panel does not look up the job description or company itself. Good answers depend on the parent passing them in.

sections.name: readFileAsBase64
sections.title: Image to text conversion
sections.what: Reads a chosen image file and turns it into plain text so it can be sent to the server. It keeps only the part of the data after the file header.
sections.why: A web request can carry text easily, but not a file directly.
sections.watch_out: Large photos become long text, which can slow the upload.

sections.name: visionExtractQuestions
sections.title: Reading questions from a screenshot
sections.what: Sends the image text to the extraction service with an instruction to list only the questions, one per line, and returns the text the service finds.
sections.why: Lets the user photograph a form instead of typing it out.
sections.watch_out: The good result depends on the server's extraction service following the instruction to output only questions.

sections.name: fetchUrlQuestions
sections.title: Reading questions from a form link
sections.what: Sends a form address and the Exa key to the fetch-url service and returns the text it finds on the page.
sections.why: Lets the user paste a form link instead of copying the questions by hand.
sections.watch_out: The Exa key is sent along with the link. A form that is private or needs a login will fail or return little text.

sections.name: FormQASection (part 1)
sections.title: Panel memory and question intake
sections.what: Holds the panel's state: open or closed, question text, link box, saved answers, progress and error messages, which answer is being edited, the chat box, and copy states. Handles screenshots one image at a time and adds the extracted text to the question box. Handles a form link the same way.
sections.why: Lets the user gather questions from three sources into one box before generating answers.
sections.watch_out: Each added source is appended to the same box, so questions stack up. The CLEAR button is the only way to reset the box.

sections.name: FormQASection (part 2)
sections.title: Generating and copying answers
sections.what: Checks that there are questions and a saved profile, then sends the questions, job description, company, role, profile and AI settings to the server to generate answers. The answers are shown and passed to the parent. Copy buttons put one answer, or all answers, on the clipboard and show a brief COPIED label.
sections.why: Generation needs the profile, so the check gives a clear message if it is missing.
sections.watch_out: Generating replaces every current answer, including any edits the user made by hand.

sections.name: FormQASection (part 3)
sections.title: Refining answers and editing one
sections.what: Sends the current answers and the user's change request to the server, then replaces the answers with the revised set and passes it to the parent. Also starts editing a single answer and saves the edited text.
sections.why: Lets the user steer or fix answers without starting over.
sections.watch_out: Refining replaces the whole set with the server's version, so any answer the server leaves out is lost. Edits are tied to an answer's position.

sections.name: FormQASection (part 4)
sections.title: Panel header and link row
sections.what: The clickable header shows the title and the number of saved answers, with an arrow for open or closed. When open, it shows an explanation, any error message, and the form link box with a FETCH button.
sections.why: Keeps the tool out of the way until the user needs it.
sections.watch_out: The link box and FETCH button are disabled while any other task is running.

sections.name: FormQASection (part 5)
sections.title: Screenshot buttons, question box and generate button
sections.what: Provides a photo button and a file button for screenshots, a status line while working, a question box with a CLEAR button, and the main GENERATE ANSWERS button. All are disabled while a task runs.
sections.why: Gives three ways to add questions and one way to produce answers.
sections.watch_out: Likely reason: the photo button asks for the camera on phones, but on desktop it may simply open a file picker.

sections.name: FormQASection (part 6)
sections.title: Saved answers list with copy and edit
sections.what: Lists each answer with its question number, question text, answer, a COPY button and an EDIT button. Editing swaps the answer for a text box with SAVE and CANCEL buttons.
sections.why: Lets the user review and change each answer before using it.
sections.watch_out: Edits are tied to the answer's position in the list. If generating or refining happens while an edit is open, the saved edit can land on a different answer.

sections.name: FormQASection (part 7)
sections.title: Refine with AI chat box
sections.what: Shows a box where the user describes a change, with examples. It sends with the APPLY EDIT button or with Ctrl or Cmd plus Enter. Shows an error if the change fails. Appears only when answers exist.
sections.why: Lets the user request changes across all answers in plain words.
sections.watch_out: If a refinement fails, the existing answers stay in place, which is safe. The error text is the only sign that nothing changed.

summary: A collapsible panel where the user adds application questions by link, screenshot or typing, has AI write answers using their profile and the job description, and lets them edit, copy and refine the results.
purpose: Speeds up filling in job application forms by drafting answers in the user's own voice for one specific job.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: many applications ask similar questions, and drafting saves time while the user keeps control by editing.
how: 1. The user opens the panel. 2. Questions are added by pasting a form link (FETCH), uploading or photographing screenshots one at a time, or typing. 3. GENERATE ANSWERS sends the questions with the job description, company, role and saved profile to the server. 4. Answers appear, and the user can COPY, EDIT, or use REFINE WITH AI for changes. 5. Each change is passed to the parent page through the save callback.
inputs: Typed questions, a form link, uploaded images, the job description, company name, role title, saved answers, the saved profile, AI model settings, the Exa key, and chat instructions.
outputs: A list of questions with answers, copied text on the clipboard, saved answers through the parent callback, and error messages.
risks: Generating replaces all current answers, including hand edits. Edits are tied to an answer's position, so regenerating or refining while editing can save the edit to a different answer. The form text, images, profile and keys are sent to the server and on to the AI service. Copy failures are not shown to the user.
debug: If generation fails, read the message under the panel and confirm the profile is saved in Settings and the AI model is configured. If FETCH fails, the form may be private, so try screenshots. If screenshots add no text, check the extraction service response. If an edit lands on the wrong answer, reload the answers and avoid generating while editing. If COPY does nothing, check the browser's clipboard permission.
